name: Plushie Adventure
source:
Welcome to the world Plushie Adventure!

Featuring new and old friends alike

Will you succeed at winning their hearts?

I trust you will not disappoint

[Edited from [url=https://funadasduna.itch.io/plushie-adventure]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《毛绒玩偶大冒险》的世界！

新朋旧友齐聚一堂

你能否成功俘获他们的芳心？

相信你一定不会让人失望

[摘自[url=https://funadasduna.itch.io/plushie-adventure]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
